Hero.tagline: Alexander Kranz, in full – I study Data Science in Hamburg, connecting data, technology and curiosity: at work, in code and out on the running track.

Home.aboutLead: I'm passionate about data – and just as much about the people and stories behind it.
Home.aboutText: I grew up in Ahrensburg and today I'm pursuing a Bachelor's in Data Science in Hamburg. I'm fascinated by how data turns into real decisions – and how technology can improve people's everyday lives.

items.title: High-altitude mountaineering
items.description: My exchange year in Ecuador turned into a love affair with the Andes. Roped up and on crampons, I summited several of the country's glaciated volcanoes — headlamp on, setting off hours before sunrise to reach the top as the first light breaks over the cordillera.
items.imageAlt: Sunrise on the top of the Chimborazo volcano in Ecuador

items.title: Scuba diving
items.description: Whenever there's an ocean nearby, I'm in it. Diving is my counterweight to the mountains — slow, weightless and quiet, with a whole ecosystem unfolding a few metres below the surface.

items.title: Marathon running
items.description: Two marathons in, and hooked. The long road teaches patience and the quiet confidence that big goals fall one kilometre at a time. The map tracks where I've toed the start line.
items.imageAlt: Runners at the finish line during a city marathon
